name: ninfs-mcp
description: Expose ninfs (3DS SD/title/ExeFS mounter) to AI agents as five safe, read-only MCP tools.
long_description: Detect the SD card, mount it read-only, resolve titles update-first, extract the decompressed ExeFS code into a workspace, and unmount. Requires Windows + WinFsp, ninfs dependencies, an SD backup, movable.sed and boot9.bin.

tools.name: find_title
tools.description: Resolve a title update-first and mount down to ExeFS

tools.name: extract_code
tools.description: Copy the decompressed code into the workspace
